label: Go with CodeQL dataflow
description: Interprocedural dataflow analysis of the Go components with CodeQL (language go, security-extended suite). Comes in by the language of a component and runs only where dataflow is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available); it never turns the check on by itself. The CodeQL CLI and its query packs are customer-supplied (GitHub CodeQL terms): without them the check is reported as not available here, never passed.
